scripts.build: next build --webpack && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('tmp', {recursive: true}); fs.writeFileSync('tmp/restart.txt', String(Date.now()));"
scripts.restart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('tmp', {recursive: true}); fs.writeFileSync('tmp/restart.txt', String(Date.now())); console.log('Application restart triggered.');"
